status: implemented; CPU reference/HTTP integration and owned M3 GPU artifact diagnostic tested; unqualified
modifications: Reuse the independently implemented MLX BERT encoder and add the actual trained tanh CLS pooler plus scalar relevance classifier. Exact artifact-byte pins and complete tensor schema. Width-one query/document pairs with 512-token longest-first right truncation; raw relevance logits with identity activation, not sigmoid probability or cosine similarity.

validation.reference: Pinned local Transformers 5.17.0 BertForSequenceClassification, eager float32 attention, actual immutable cached artifact, eight query/document pairs covering normal, Unicode, and truncation cases. Exact pair token IDs/type IDs and retained token accounting; repeat determinism.
validation.integration: Actual ServingEngine and HTTP rerank route returns sorted raw relevance logits, document selection, token usage and artifact/recipe/observed-use receipts. Unsupported embedding/generation/tokenization requests refuse, quiesce/resume/close retain operation ownership. Existing decoder cosine behavior remains unchanged.
validation.negative_controls: Metadata activation drift, missing/extra/wrong-shape/wrong-dtype weights and malformed/oversized input refuse. No trained head or route is fabricated.

validation.result: Reordering embedding top10 on 24 SciFact queries / 360 candidates decreased nDCG@10 from 0.7674088957813697 to 0.7449639865396994. No quality/default promotion.

validation.kind: owned Apple M3 Pro MLX GPU artifact diagnostic
validation.result: Exact pinned embedding and reranker payloads loaded under CPG generation 2027 and both GPU locks. Two reranker executions were bit-exact and ranked the relevant rollback document first; MLX default device was gpu. Peak memory for both resident adapters and diagnostic work was 216,332,953 bytes.

artifact.weight_schema: Exact F32 learned tensors and I64 position_ids; exact metadata byte hashes; immutable verified payload passed directly to MLX loader.

limits: Only the exact pinned artifact is supported; no arbitrary BERT classifier, remote code, implicit download, quantization or dynamic head loading.
Raw identity-activation relevance logits are not calibrated probabilities; no sigmoid is silently applied.
Width-one pairs with longest-first right truncation at 512 tokens; query and document share that budget.
Embedding, generation, KV/APCv2, streaming and generation policies are unsupported for this adapter. Existing generative cosine reranking remains a separate contract.

Owned M3 GPU execution is observed for the exact pinned artifacts. No full preflight, formal route qualification, performance claim or broad retrieval-quality qualification is made. The bounded scientific retrieval result does not support default reranking.
